# Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(here)
library(ggforce)
library(ggh4x)
library(bestNormalize)
library(ggResidpanel)
library(broom)
```

#theme 

```{r}
nunu_theme <- theme_bw()+ 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=24, face = "bold"), 
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size=20),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        legend.title=element_text(size=18, face = "bold"),
        legend.text=element_text(size=16),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))
```

# Data
```{r, message=FALSE}
mobeast <- read_csv(here("data", "mobeast_flux.csv"))
```

# Data clean up 
```{r}
mobeast<- mobeast %>% mutate(date_string = as.character(date_string), 
                   time_string = as.character(time_string), 
                   date_time_string= as.character(date_time_string))
mobeast %>% select(variable_cat, variable) %>% distinct()
```

# Flux Linear regression 


```{r}
# test regression
DOC <- mobeast %>% filter(variable == "npoc_u_m") %>% filter(outlier != "outlier")

DOC_mod <- lm(asinh(areal_flux) ~ flowrate, data = DOC)
summary(DOC_mod)

resid_panel(DOC_mod)

```


```{r}

## we want to know how many NA values are created when data is transformed.
mobeast %>% 
  #filter(variable == "npoc_u_m") %>% 
  mutate(areal_flux_log10 = log10(areal_flux),
         areal_flux_sqrt = sqrt(areal_flux),
         areal_flux_log1p = sqrt(areal_flux),
         areal_flux_asinh = asinh(areal_flux),
         areal_flux_sign = sign(areal_flux) * log1p(abs(areal_flux))) %>% 
  select(variable, variable_cat, areal_flux_log10, areal_flux_sqrt,
         areal_flux_log1p,areal_flux_asinh, areal_flux_sign) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = areal_flux_log10:areal_flux_sign,
               names_to = "transformation", values_to = "trans_value"
                ) %>% 
  group_by(variable, transformation) %>%
  filter(is.na(trans_value)) %>% 
  reframe(n=n())

## log10, log1p and sqrt cause a lot of data loss... up to 1/2 of the data set in same cases. 
## asinh() and sign(x)*log1p(abs(x)) are better alternatives because they limited the data loss but the QQ plots aren't as good...  

```

```{r}
mobeast %>% 
  #filter(variable == "npoc_u_m") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(sample = areal_flux)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line( color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(.~ variable, scales = "free")

```

```{r}
# automated model computation 
models <- mobeast %>%
  filter(outlier != "outlier") %>% 
  mutate(areal_flux = (areal_flux))%>% 
  group_by(variable) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ lm(areal_flux ~ flowrate, data = .x)),
    results = map(model, tidy),
    stats = map(model, glance)
  )
```



```{r}
lm_results <- models %>% unnest(results) %>% 
  select(variable, term, estimate, std.error, t_value = statistic, p.value)
lm_results %>% filter(p.value<0.05, term == "flowrate")
```

```{r}
# not all stats are saved in the DF
lm_stats <- models %>% unnest(stats) %>%  select(variable, r.squared, adj.r.squared,
                                     RSE = sigma, F_stat = statistic, p.value,  DF = df.residual)

lm_stats %>% filter(p.value <0.05)
```



```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.height=12, fig.width=20}

mobeast %>% 
  filter(outlier != "outlier") %>% 
  filter(variable_cat == "DOC"|variable_cat == "chla") %>% 
  #filter(variable =="pro"|variable =="syn"|variable =="pico_euk"|variable =="het_bact") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = flowrate, y = asinh(areal_flux), color = treatment)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(shape = 21,color = "black", size = 2)+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", nrow= 2, ncol = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Flow rate",
    y = "Flux",
    title = "Flow rate vs Flux for each variable"
  )+
  scale_color_manual(
        breaks = c("Control", "Coral", "CCA", "Algae"),
        values = c("grey", "#03A9F4", "#EF5350", "#4CAF50")
      ) +
  nunu_theme
```

```{r, fig.height=50, fig.width=5}
mobeast %>% 
  filter(outlier != "outlier") %>% 
  ggplot( aes(x = flowrate, y = sign(areal_flux) * log1p(abs(areal_flux)))) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  
  facet_nested(
    variable_cat + variable~. ,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Flow rate",
    y = "Flux",
    title = "Flow rate vs Flux grouped by category"
  )
```



# Delta values Linear regression 

```{r}
## tidyverse 
models_delta_tidy <- mobeast %>%
  filter(outlier != "outlier") %>% 
  group_by(variable) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ lm(asinh(conc_norm) ~ flowrate, data = .x)),
    results = map(model, tidy),
    stats = map(model, glance)
  )

### for loop 
delta_loop <- mobeast %>% select(variable) %>% distinct() %>% pull()

models_delta <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(delta_loop))
names(models_delta) <- delta_loop

for (var in delta_loop) {
  df <- mobeast %>% filter(outlier != "outlier") %>% filter(variable == var)
  models_delta[[var]] <- lm(asinh(conc_norm) ~ flowrate, data = df)
}
```

```{r}
for (var in names(models_delta)) {
  
  mod <- models_delta[[var]]
  cook <- cooks.distance(mod)
  
  if(max(cook) > 4/length(cook)) {
    cat(var, "has influential point(s)\n")
  }
}
```



```{r}
delta_results <- models_delta_tidy %>% unnest(results) %>% 
  select(variable, term, estimate, std.error, t_value = statistic, p.value)
delta_results %>% filter(p.value<0.05, term == "flowrate")
```



```{r}
# not all stats are saved in the DF
delta_stats <- models_delta_tidy %>% unnest(stats) %>%  select(variable, r.squared, adj.r.squared,
                                     RSE = sigma, F_stat = statistic, p.value,  DF = df.residual)

delta_stats %>% filter(p.value <0.05)

```


```{r}
mobeast %>% 
  #filter(variable == "npoc_u_m") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(sample = (conc_norm))) +
  #ggplot(aes(sample = sign(conc_norm) * log1p(abs(conc_norm)))) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line( color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(.~ variable, scales = "free")

```

```{r}
## work in progress : identify the values that are influential to the regression for 1 variable
mod <- models_delta[["NO3"]]

df_used <- model.frame(mod)

cook <- cooks.distance(mod)

influential_points <- df_used[cook > 4/length(cook), ]
```

```{r}
## work in progress : trying to merge the results that to the orginal df to know what points are influential 
influential_points <- df_used %>%
  mutate(cook = cook) %>%
  filter(cook > 4/n())
```



```{r}
## work in progress : identify the values that are influential to the regression 

influential_df <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(models_delta), function(var) {
    
    mod <- models_delta[[var]]
    
    df_var <- mobeast %>%
      filter(outlier != "outlier", variable == var)
    
    cook <- cooks.distance(mod)
    
    df_var %>%
      mutate(cook = cook) %>%
      filter(cook > 4/n())
  }),
  .id = "variable"
)
```


```{r}
## work in progress : identify the values that are not influential to the regression 
clean_df <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(models_delta), function(var) {
    
    mod <- models_delta[[var]]
    
    df_var <- mobeast %>%
      filter(outlier != "outlier", variable == var)
    
    cook <- cooks.distance(mod)
    
    df_var %>%
      mutate(cook = cook) %>%
      filter(cook <= 4/n())
  }),
  .id = "variable"
)
```
